name: Stillwater Masjid
summary: A single-minaret mosque rests above one softly flowing waterline.
why: The broad dome and tall minaret balance opposite sides of one joined hall. The open doorway follows the dome axis. A single wide wave sits beneath the full building, separated by a deliberate open interval.
risk: The water introduces a peaceful metaphor rather than an explicit prayer-time cue. Its shape stays broad so it does not become a decorative underline.
sub1: One dome and one slender minaret

palette.name: STILLWATER MASJID / SLATE + PEARL + SEA GLASS

reasonToChoose: You want a peaceful identity with a clear architectural heart.
